RELEASE NOTES — M5 FINAL DELIVERY v1.0

Purpose
Final delivery of the recovered and provenance-separated MAMMON / APPLE / Eden Initiative Twenty-Five Years After 9/11 corpus.

Branches
1. MAMMON-related recovered material.
2. APPLE material used as a derived MAMMON quality/decision overlay.
3. Eden 25th Anniversary recovered corpus and related source material.

Known unresolved historical gaps are intentionally retained as unresolved rather than fabricated.
This release closes the recovery-package pipeline; it does not assert completion of the later research/publication programme.
